scope: headless numeric sensors and anonymous per-episode action handles
task_independence: Different hand-authored transition families; common engineered observable numeric sensor/goal/action schema; NOT independently selected blind domains.

controls.no_leakage: Learning may only consume public observations and public transition outcomes; never receive world hidden prerequisites, simulator family identifier, protected goal action, or an oracle planning trace
controls.no_tuning: Report all results; reserved cohort tested only once after freezing implementation; later changes must label reserve as inspected

nonclaims: opaque per-episode action handles prevent lexical skill lookup across episodes
study evaluates a common local probing algorithm, not transfer of task-specific learned models
simulated reward is not human agency or consciousness
historical: Existing outcome-skills, transfer, raw-token, prerequisite/prober/recovery protocols and main branch remain unchanged
